runtimeProof.meaning: Vectors prove the specification rejects a mutation. The owners in the ownership catalog prove a running system does; pending owners are expected.

encoding.canonicalJson: RFC 8785 member order; safe integers only; NFC strings; no duplicate keys
encoding.digest: sha256 over the domain, one NUL byte and the canonical JSON

locatorIndependence.law: Two locators of one verified artifact share one key and keep two origin receipts.

policyChange.law: A compatibility policy or requirement change alters the cache key, so a stale receipt cannot authorize the new basis.

validationOrder.law: Every check runs before candidate code. A trust row fails before any compatibility verdict is consulted, and compatibility is read from declarations, never by executing the candidate.

operationalStatuses.meaning: Exhaustive absence with no rejected candidate
A verified local artifact is missing while offline
The request was cancelled or superseded
The validator could not finish for an operational reason

layout.artifactKeyEncoding: the hex of EngineArtifactId's key; the manifest repeats the full structural ID and is compared on load

transitions.action: create a private exclusive sibling and take the artifact-scoped lock
bounded extraction, no links, no special files
shared validator proves the closure, then files are flushed
atomic no-replace rename into the versioned entry, then flush the parent
publish READY.json last, then flush the entry
move a corrupt or revoked managed entry aside

platformPrimitives.noFollowOpen: openat with O_NOFOLLOW and O_DIRECTORY, then fstat
platformPrimitives.atomicNoReplace: renameat2 RENAME_NOREPLACE; a filesystem refusing it fails closed
platformPrimitives.privateRoot: owner equals euid and mode has no group or world write

platformPrimitives.noFollowOpen: openat with O_NOFOLLOW and O_DIRECTORY, then fstat
platformPrimitives.atomicNoReplace: renameatx_np RENAME_EXCL; a filesystem refusing it fails closed
platformPrimitives.privateRoot: owner equals euid and mode has no group or world write
platformPrimitives.durability: fcntl F_FULLFSYNC on files and parent directory

platformPrimitives.noFollowOpen: CreateFileW with FILE_FLAG_OPEN_REPARSE_POINT and FILE_FLAG_BACKUP_SEMANTICS, refusing FILE_ATTRIBUTE_REPARSE_POINT
platformPrimitives.exclusiveCreate: CreateDirectoryW and CREATE_NEW with an owner-only protected DACL
platformPrimitives.atomicNoReplace: MoveFileExW without MOVEFILE_REPLACE_EXISTING on one volume
platformPrimitives.privateRoot: owner is the current user or an administrator and the DACL grants nobody else write
platformPrimitives.durability: FlushFileBuffers on files and directory handles

admission.law: No negative result is cached, so a rejected or unknown answer cannot survive a fact that could change it.

cache.flight: One validation per full key. A superseded flight cancels its publication and its result is Stale.
cache.retention: Local entry and byte bounds for validation evidence; the cache retains no semantic artifact and is outside the semantic retention account.

work.measurement: Work counts and growth ratios decide acceptance; timing, allocation and memory comparisons are reported, never gated.

population.current: A path plus a probed version string is the whole validated identity.
Candidate code runs for a version probe and handshake before any origin, integrity or trust check.
Rejections carry a rendered message rather than a stable typed reason and remediation class.
Tier order and first-working fallback decide the candidate, with source-specific validation.
READY is a file-existence check; it binds neither the manifest nor the executed bytes.
A shared-temp cache root is path-checked and later reopened, so the check does not bind the opened file.
A host-relative path and sibling manifest stand in for validated shipped bytes.
Package metadata alone classifies an install, and an unreadable version fails open.
A second resolver holds its own tiers, rejections and fallback.
Editor code selects an engine from SDK paths and environment by itself.
Finding a workspace package is treated as permission to load it.
The CLI rebuilds its own selection, which would survive as a second owner after the shared resolver lands.
A caller-supplied path starts an engine with no revalidated receipt.
The shim executes a path taken from an argument or the environment.
Status infers availability from provider kind rather than a current activation receipt.

conditionJustifications.condition: Identity keeps every structural axis, and a locator never enters it
conditionJustifications.prevents: Two different artifacts aliasing under one path and version, which the current path/version tuple permits today
conditionJustifications.notCoveredBecause: No shared identity exists for CI or review to compare against

conditionJustifications.condition: Origin, closure and trust checks precede any candidate execution
conditionJustifications.prevents: A substituted engine running during its own version probe, reachable by anyone able to place an executable on a searched path
conditionJustifications.notCoveredBecause: Current validators run the candidate first, so no existing test can observe the ordering

conditionJustifications.condition: READY binds the manifest and is published last into a private no-follow layout
conditionJustifications.prevents: A partial or attacker-placed cache entry becoming selectable after a crash or race
conditionJustifications.notCoveredBecause: The current marker is a file-existence check and the installer does not exist yet

conditionJustifications.condition: Reuse requires an unchanged complete key and no negative result is retained
conditionJustifications.prevents: A revoked or replaced engine reusing an earlier positive receipt
conditionJustifications.notCoveredBecause: No shared receipt cache exists for CI to exercise

conditionJustifications.condition: Finite entry, byte, closure and extraction bounds with named counters
conditionJustifications.prevents: Unbounded retained evidence or a decompression bomb as candidates grow
conditionJustifications.notCoveredBecause: No validation cache or extractor exists to measure

conditionJustifications.condition: Public status is an allowlisted projection and portable records carry no roots or credentials
conditionJustifications.prevents: Proxy credentials or home paths leaking through status and logs
conditionJustifications.notCoveredBecause: Status adapters that would carry these fields are not implemented

conditionJustifications.condition: Every outcome, consumer and displaced route binds one production-capable owner with a checked path and acceptance
conditionJustifications.prevents: A runtime obligation falling between successors while the contract reads as complete
conditionJustifications.notCoveredBecause: The controller checks node dependencies, not this contract's obligation population
